policy.purpose: Resolve age-screen findings through source-level currency review without changing source rights, evidence approval, instructional approval, or assessment eligibility.

reviews.rationale: 49 CFR 571.126 remains in the current eCFR and continues to establish ESC equipment and performance requirements for light vehicles.
reviews.usageConstraint: Use the current codified text for regulatory requirements; the original 2007 rulemaking date does not make the standard obsolete.

reviews.rationale: Current NIST information-quality guidance still identifies Technical Note 1900 as guidance for evaluating and expressing measurement uncertainty.
reviews.usageConstraint: Retain as current measurement-uncertainty guidance; apply it within its NIST measurement-results scope.

reviews.rationale: NASA continues to publish the 2016 Systems Engineering Handbook as current agency guidance. NASA-HDBK-1009A (2025) provides newer, narrower model-based systems engineering guidance and complements rather than generally replaces the handbook.
reviews.usageConstraint: Retain for general systems-engineering foundations; use NASA-HDBK-1009A where model-based systems engineering or SysML-specific practice is the instructional focus.

reviews.rationale: The SAE technical paper remains available and useful as a bounded Nissan/Infiniti CAN diagnostic-flow case study, but it is not a current universal OEM service procedure.
reviews.usageConstraint: Use only as historical/supporting diagnostic-method context. Current vehicle diagnosis must defer to current OEM service information and vehicle-specific procedures.

reviews.rationale: The peer-reviewed survey remains relevant as literature on model-based and data-driven automotive engine fault-detection methods, but its age makes it unsuitable as a standalone statement of current diagnostic practice.
reviews.usageConstraint: Use as scholarly background, research-method context, and historical literature support; do not treat it as current service information or current regulatory guidance.
